criteria.text: Treatment of one of the five listed conditions.
Patient has compliantly taken at least 1,000–2,000 IU vitamin D daily for at least 6 months and failed to correct vitamin D deficiency; lab results submitted with the request.
Medication is not being used as a dietary supplement.

notes: RETIRED ALIAS: this slug is a mislabeled scrape of drisdol-criteria.pdf, identical to vitamin-d-50 (Drisdol / Vitamin D 50,000 IU).
Pack retains the same partial predicates as vitamin-d-50 so evaluate() stays usable if the slug is reached; prefer vitamin-d-50 as the canonical pack.
Removed from unfinished text_only denominator by aliasing to the vitamin-d-50 encoding.

Partial encoding of Drisdol criteria. Rules engine is the sole eligibility evaluator. The five listed indication paths are alternatives; only the vitamin D deficiency path requires the daily treatment failure and submitted laboratory results attestation.
FDA indication (notes only): “DRISDOL is indicated for use in the treatment of hypoparathyroidism, refractory rickets, also known as vitamin D resistant rickets, and familial hypophosphatemia.”
Secondary hyperparathyroidism is an additional approval path supported by footnote 2: Ergocalciferol, Vitamin D2 monograph, Clinical Pharmacology; accessed 12/1/2010.
Authorization (notes only): may be granted for up to 12 months.
Reference / footnote 1: Drisdol package insert, http://products.sanofi-aventis.us/drisdol/drisdol.pdf; accessed 12/1/2010.
Drisdol Criteria Version 1; Last updated 1/06/2011; Approved 1/21/2011. Extracted effective date is null; existing 1970-01-01 effective_date is retained as a metadata stub.
